interventions_observed: First request changed implementation and tests, then a malformed model tool-call final failed generation1.
Operator selected Continue; generation2 also failed with malformed output.
A proposed guidance message was not sent because the resumed composer returned a Session conflict.
Operator refreshed and finished the failed turn, then sent a new recovery request explicitly asking for Scout delegation.
Lead and Scout completed the recovery turn and the host ran six passing tests. Independent diff review found two original tests removed.
Operator sent a third request restoring removed tests. Qwen restored renamed tests but again ended with a malformed tool-call final.
Operator changed the Lead in Team and budget to local GPT-OSS20B and disabled helpers.
A fourth request restored the exact original test blocks. GPT-OSS completed; the host check passed8/8.
Independent artifact review accepted the final uncommitted implementation and tests.

encoding.frames: All retained original samples, chronological; privacy or editorial omissions declared; repeated frames only, no interpolation or generated UI.
encoding.timing: Explicit privacy omissions, uncaptured segment gaps and declared speedups are mapped in the timeline; every retained sample is preserved.
encoding.color_conversion: Original full-range JPEG samples converted to standard limited-range yuv420p for H.264; original JPEG bytes retained unchanged.
encoding.verification: Every retained JPEG sample must match an encoded video frame at SSIM>=0.99 within one24fps frame (1/24second) of its mapped midpoint, allowing only source/seek timestamp quantization. Asset hashes and source mappings remain exact.
encoding.frame_quantization: Each retained sample receives the interval between its cumulative source-mapped boundaries rounded to24fps; every interval contains at least one output frame. FFconcat input is explicitly24Hz.

outcome_scope: Recorded task only; no comparative evaluation or general reliability inference.

captions.text:
A prepared Node pagination task in the actual 1.5 dashboard.
Recorded in segments; navigation and waits shortened.
Create a Session. Approve npm ci and the local team.
Request the fix, preserve existing tests, and add regressions.
Follow the Qwen3-Coder Lead in the Agent graph.
A malformed model response fails. The operator selects Continue.

The retry also fails. Guidance hits a Session conflict;
the operator starts a new recovery request.
The Lead delegates a read-only inspection to GPT-OSS Scout.
Host checks pass, then the operator inspects the changes.

Review finds two original tests removed.
Restoration is requested; that turn also fails.
Switch the Lead to local GPT-OSS20B and disable helpers.
A fourth request restores the exact original test blocks.
Final turn completes. The host check passes all 8 tests.
Review the final implementation and tests; changes stay uncommitted.

Independent acceptance: original 4 tests retained, 8 tests pass.
This was a recovered four-request task, not one-shot success.

limitations: Scout reported tests it had not run: its approved tools were read-only file tools, with no shell. Actual test outcomes are established by the host-required checks and independent artifact checks.
The prepared fixture and recovered result do not establish comparative quality or general reliability.
